          'Hello World' GLOB 'Hello*' as glob_star_end,
          'Hello World' GLOB '*World' as glob_star_start,
          'Hello World' GLOB 'Hello?World' as glob_question,
          'Hello World' GLOB 'hello*' as glob_case_sensitive,
          'test123' GLOB 'test[0-9][0-9][0-9]' as glob_bracket_range,
          'testABC' GLOB 'test[A-Z]*' as glob_bracket_alpha,
          'test1' GLOB 'test[^0-9]' as glob_bracket_negate,
          'test_file.txt' GLOB '*.txt' as glob_extension;

SELECT 
          'test%file' LIKE 'test%' as like_percent_literal_no_escape,
          'test%file' LIKE 'test#%%' ESCAPE '#' as like_percent_literal_escape,
          'test_file' LIKE 'test#_file' ESCAPE '#' as like_underscore_literal_escape,
          '50%' LIKE '%#%%' ESCAPE '#' as like_match_percent_end;

SELECT 
          'Hello' || ' ' || 'World' as concat_strings,
          'Value: ' || 42 as concat_string_int,
          'Pi: ' || 3.14159 as concat_string_float,
          'Test' || NULL as concat_null,
          '' || 'test' as concat_empty_left,
          'test' || '' as concat_empty_right,
          NULL || NULL as concat_both_null;

CREATE TABLE unicode_test(text TEXT);
        INSERT INTO unicode_test VALUES 
          ('Hello 世界'),
          ('Emoji: 🚀🌟'),
          ('Greek: αβγδ'),
          ('Arabic: مرحبا');
        SELECT 
          text,
          length(text) as char_length,
          octet_length(text) as byte_length,
          upper(text) as upper_text,
          substr(text, 1, 5) as first_5_chars
        FROM unicode_test;

SELECT 
          substring('SQLite', 1, 3) as substring_alias,
          substring('SQLite', -3, 2) as substring_negative,
          substr('0123456789', 5) as substr_from_middle,
          substr('0123456789', -5) as substr_negative_no_len,
          substr('0123456789', 1, 100) as substr_len_exceeds,
          substr('test', 3, 0) as substr_zero_length;

SELECT 
          printf('%10s', 'test') as printf_width,
          printf('%-10s', 'test') as printf_left_align,
          printf('%*s', 10, 'test') as printf_dynamic_width,
          printf('%.*s', 3, 'testing') as printf_dynamic_precision,
          printf('%c', 65) as printf_char,
          printf('%o', 64) as printf_octal,
          printf('%e', 123.456) as printf_scientific;

SELECT 
          trim('   ') as trim_only_spaces,
          ltrim('   ') as ltrim_only_spaces,
          rtrim('   ') as rtrim_only_spaces,
          trim('   hello   ', ' ') as trim_spaces_explicit,
          replace('test test test', 'test', 'TEST') as replace_all_occurrences,
          replace('aaaa', 'aa', 'b') as replace_overlapping;

SELECT 
          '' LIKE '' as like_empty_both,
          'test' LIKE '' as like_empty_pattern,
          '' LIKE '%' as like_empty_string_percent,
          'a' LIKE '_' as like_single_char_match,
          'ab' LIKE '_' as like_single_char_no_match,
          'test' LIKE 't%t' as like_start_end,
          '%' LIKE '#%' ESCAPE '#' as like_literal_percent_match,
          '_' LIKE '#_' ESCAPE '#' as like_literal_underscore_match;

SELECT 
          '' GLOB '' as glob_empty_both,
          'test' GLOB '' as glob_empty_pattern,
          '' GLOB '*' as glob_empty_string_star,
          'a' GLOB '?' as glob_single_char_match,
          'ab' GLOB '?' as glob_single_char_no_match,
          'test.txt' GLOB 'test.*' as glob_literal_dot,
          '[' GLOB '[[]' as glob_bracket_literal;

SELECT 
          length(replace('x', '', 'y')) as replace_empty_search_length,
          substr('abcdefghij', 5, 3) as substr_middle,
          instr('abcabcabc', 'abc') as instr_multiple_first,
          printf('%s', replace('test', '', '')) as nested_operations;

SELECT 
          quote('It''s a test') as quote_single_quotes,
          quote(X'00FF') as quote_binary,
          quote(3.14) as quote_float,
          quote(-42) as quote_negative;

SELECT 
          hex('') as hex_empty,
          unhex('') as unhex_empty,
          unhex('00') as unhex_null_byte,
          unhex('4142434445') as unhex_abcde,
          hex(unhex('48656C6C6F')) as hex_roundtrip;

SELECT 
          char(0) as char_null_byte,
          char(9, 10, 13) as char_whitespace,
          char(65535) as char_max_utf16,
          length(char(65)) as char_length,
          char() as char_no_args;

CREATE TABLE test_patterns(text TEXT);
        INSERT INTO test_patterns VALUES 
          ('test123'),
          ('Test456'),
          ('TEST789'),
          ('special!@#'),
          ('with spaces'),
          ('');
        SELECT 
          text,
          text LIKE 'test%' as like_lower,
          text LIKE 'TEST%' as like_upper,
          text GLOB 'test*' as glob_lower,
          text GLOB 'TEST*' as glob_upper,
          text LIKE '%[0-9]%' as like_has_bracket,
          text GLOB '*[0-9]' as glob_has_digit
        FROM test_patterns;

SELECT 
          upper(lower('TeSt')) as upper_lower_roundtrip,
          lower(upper('TeSt')) as lower_upper_roundtrip,
          replace(replace('test', 't', 'T'), 'e', 'E') as double_replace,
          substr(substr('abcdefghij', 3), 2, 3) as nested_substr,
          length(trim('  hello  ')) as length_after_trim,
          instr(upper('hello world'), 'WORLD') as instr_on_upper;

CREATE TABLE users(id INT, name TEXT, email TEXT);
        INSERT INTO users VALUES 
          (1, 'Alice Smith', 'alice@example.com'),
          (2, 'Bob Johnson', 'bob@test.org'),
          (3, 'Charlie Brown', 'charlie@example.com'),
          (4, 'David Wilson', NULL);
        SELECT 
          id,
          name,
          substr(name, 1, instr(name, ' ') - 1) as first_name,
          substr(name, instr(name, ' ') + 1) as last_name,
          lower(email) as email_lower,
          length(name) as name_length
        FROM users
        WHERE email LIKE '%@example.com'
        ORDER BY id;

SELECT 
          'test' NOT LIKE 'TEST' as not_like_case,
          'test' NOT LIKE 'xyz' as not_like_no_match,
          'test123' NOT GLOB 'test[0-9]*' as not_glob_match,
          NOT ('test' LIKE 't%') as not_operator_like;

SELECT 
          printf('%d', '42') as printf_string_to_int,
          printf('%s', 42) as printf_int_to_string,
          printf('%f', '3.14') as printf_string_to_float,
          printf('%d %s', 1, 'test') as printf_multiple_types;
